case.summary: The investigation concluded that transaction 3530164 on card C08623‑K2 is a legitimate, authorized cardholder purchase with no indication of compromise. Review of the transaction showed it fell within the customer’s typical spend limits, originated from the cardholder’s known device profile, and the customer confirmed the activity during outreach; no linked cards or suspicious patterns were identified. Accordingly, a case was created, the customer was warned of vigilance best practices, and the matter was closed with a “no fraud” disposition per bank policy.
